snippet.title: ReBlade: The Death Spiral | Steam Next Fest Demo Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Demo on Steam now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3489340/ReBlade_The_Death_Spiral/

In ReBlade: The Death Spiral, you play as a condemned Synthetic trapped in a cyberpunk world distorted by false immortality and endless resets. 

You must fight through a city overrun by mechanical creatures, and refine your build by combining weapons, chips, and augments as each cycle uncovers new strategies and combat possibilities. 

Through repeated resets, you learn, adapt, and push deeper into the city, gradually uncovering the truth behind this mysterious world and carving your path to freedom.
